trigger: In the completed S100A8/9 source vector, a beta/SE ratio of about 47 coexists with nominal P about 0.000445. Check the distribution convention before interpreting normal-approximation BF coverage. Original association fields and numerical coverage remain unchanged.
scope: All PRKD2 rows in all four original IBDverse contexts; no association or cohort selection by this diagnostic.
method: Compare exported two-sided nominal P with Student-t probabilities for every integer residual degree of freedom from 1 through 500, using abs(beta/SE). Choose the integer minimizing median absolute log10-P discrepancy; report 95th percentile and maximum discrepancies for the chosen integer and the normal distribution. This is a consistency inference, not a source-backed sample count or recovered covariate list.
gaussian_approximation_flag: Flag very low inferred residual degrees of freedom (<30); do not promote numerical Gaussian-ABF coverage to model qualification. No posteriors are calculated.
